brand_vibe.description: Logo (white background, seen on Booksy 'logo' field and watermarked into most portfolio photos): a black-line eye/lash/brow illustration with pink/rose script 'Beauty by' and a pink lipstick kiss mark, serif 'Karen Studio' wordmark. Real photos are bright, well-lit, warm skin tones, glam finished lash and brow results. This reads as a fresh, feminine, glam beauty studio aesthetic rather than moody/editorial, so a LIGHT base was chosen (Amani exemplar) with a rose/berry accent instead of Amani's mocha.
brand_vibe.palette_name: karenstudio (blush cream + deep rose/berry, new palette, does not reuse mizu/amani/mare/alea/pausa/eme/iconicbeauty)

language_evidence: All 12 Instagram Reel captions are in English ("Hybrid lashes & healed ombre brows", "Book all you beauty services", "Come see me in wpb, fl", "Come do a brow wax w. me", "Lip blush", "Brow lami", "Ombre brows", "Aftercare kits", "Hybrid"). IG bio is in English. Booksy JSON-LD reviews are predominantly in English (3 of 3 sampled: Cece, CECI M, Tina), matching the 3 client quotes given in the task (all English). No Spanish captions, hashtags, or reviews found anywhere. English (en) is used as the primary/default site language, with Spanish as the secondary toggle language.

Also rejected: 1 Instagram Reels poster with 'Beauty by Karen / Hybrid lashes / Healed ombre brows' caption text baked into the image, and 2 Booksy inspiration photos with closed-eye brow before/afters that were kept in reserve but not used in the final 6-tile gallery in favor of the stronger open-eye and no-clutter shots (final gallery already reached 6 tiles with the better images). Deliberately avoided any photo of Karen's face without a mask/eyes-down angle as a gallery tile; the one studio photo of Karen used (about-studio-karen.jpg / avatar-karen.jpg) shows her masked and focused on work, used only as a small avatar plus one full about-section photo, consistent with the 'no selfies/portraits as gallery tiles' rule.
